scope: One manual full-scene mesh interference review of every wire and cable jacket against larger bodies; wire-to-wire and wire-to-tube contacts are excluded. Tessellated penetration is a routing witness, not a native-solid or physical assembly qualification.
endpoint_contact_scope: Only the named endpoint part within 8.5 mm of its attachment. All other contact with that part remains in the reading.

production_solids.scope: Production f64 mesh-kernel solids, closed and connected, with exact standalone-to-installed viewer vertex and triangle arrays. The installed STEP retains native physical bodies and attaches the separate mesh-kernel wiring export.

preparation_lengths.scope: Developed lengths from this actual exported manifest compared with current preparation stock. The compressor hot allocation includes both AC4-H and AC4-fuse pieces; the reservoir-A common includes all three continuing earth spans. Remaining stock is a nominal cutting allowance, not physical dressing or termination qualification.
